feeds.title: Tokyo in Pics
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Rohan Gillett and welcome to my website, Tokyo in Pics. Originally from the Sunshine Coast in Australia, I came to Tokyo in 1991 and fell in love with the city. Since then I've had a variety of jobs - English teacher, wedding celebrant, tour guide & even ran a furniture company for a few years. Since 2010 I also added blogging. And to provide pictures for my blog I needed to take up photography. I used to shoot primarily Pentax cameras, but now I use a Fujifilm X-T2 & Ricoh GR3.
